title: customer.export_requested v2
description: A GDPR data export was requested for one customer of one store — by staff (Admin API exportCustomer) or by the customer (Store API requestMyExport). The consumer builds the bundle through the core and delivers it; the payload carries ids only, never personal data. v2 adds requested_by_type; requested_by is the staff_user id or the customer id accordingly.

requested_by.description: staff_user id (requested_by_type staff) or customer id (requested_by_type customer)
